findings.result: The zero, one, two and three selection states explain the next action; adding the third is optional, the explicit compare action appears after two, and the full chosen names remain readable at both widths.

The heading identifies the slot being changed. The sticky query remains visible after scrolling, current PP and already selected PSOE are visibly distinct, and the empty result state keeps clear and close actions. Escape restores focus to the original slot and preserves all three selections.
The Spanish message and keyboard-reachable reload action are readable at both widths. Tab reaches reload through the shell links; Enter reloads successfully and focuses the restored start action.

Failure keeps the checkpoint and twenty answers, names no personalised party, restores the finish action, and explains that retry is possible. Successful retry shows all 59 formation cards from the same twenty answers. Error and result states remain readable at both widths.
